title: RawEvent
description: An event as accepted by the ingest layer, before parsing. The ingest service stamps received_at and ingest_node_id; everything else is whatever the source sent.

event_id.description: UUID v7. Generated by ingest if the source did not provide one.

tenant_id.description: Multi-tenant key. Defaults to 'default' for unauthenticated sources.

received_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp at the moment of acceptance.

ingest_node_id.description: Identifier of the ingest replica that accepted the event.

transport.description: How the event arrived at the ingest layer.

raw.description: The original payload, as received. Free-form.
